findings.reviewer: independent contract reviewer (C14 review rounds 2 to 4)
findings.basis: The vanilla creative-inventory tab with its bevel lines redrawn: 522 of its 570 opaque pixels equal 1.20.1 creative_inventory/tabs.png at (1, 34) and again at (157, 34), where the sheet repeats the tab; the equal pixels are the fill (456), all 41 white bevel pixels and 25 of the 32 dark ones (C14R2-H1, C14R3-H1, C14R4-L2; reports in docs/work/v1.8.0-preparation/reviews/). The derivation check scores it CLEAR: every 4 x 4 block of three or more colours touches a moved bevel line, so no block votes for the alignment (ADR-061 section 4.8, known limits). This finding keeps it excluded, and its tab-button derivatives inherit review (ADR-061 section 4.8).
